upstream.scope: Semantic inspection and in-process automation of the Process Explorer through the existing T35 API (D1 §22.9, §7.7, §18.2; D2 T24, T35): controls located by semantic identity, role, label or text over real SSH into the unchanged generic client; harmless view actions (Pause view/Resume view, Refresh now, a row selection) invoked through EventOutbox and proved at the wire identical in frame shape, logical channel, event_seq space and ServerEventAck settlement to native clicks; disabled and unsupported controls refused identically with no frame; a selection-plus-inspection scenario; a developer-only semantic inspection report naming no AppKit type; lsof proof that no listener is opened. Test-only change: no client, SDK, runtime, protocol, registry, srtop or generated-file change, and no XPC, TCP or unix-socket endpoint

entries.feature: Pause view and Resume view located through T35 SemanticInspector.findAll(role: .button, label:) while the native button is hidden and untitled, so neither a native-view lookup nor a coordinate hit test can find it; native, automated, automated, native activations of the same node give four ACTIVATE frames of one shape (every field but event_seq, event_id and observed_revision equal; no arguments; edit_seq 0) on the same logical class (input), with contiguous event_seq, the automated observed_revision equal to the handle's snapshot revision and the native one within the revisions published around the click; each settled by a PROCESSED ServerEventAck of one shape that echoes event_id and client_instance_id, names the live session and has revision_after_effect at or past the observed revision; the outbox ends empty with last_acked_event_seq at the fourth event

A disabled control refuses automation exactly as it refuses a native click: with the view paused, Refresh now is enabled=false in the semantic snapshot and the native button; activate() throws nodeDisabled, a native click sends no action, and the same interaction delivered to the client (renderer.onInteraction) is refused by the same validation, silently in both cases; a Text line activated semantically and natively gives the same unsupportedAction (the native one reported through the client's diagnostic hook); none of the refusals sends a frame or consumes an event_seq, the server stays paused, and the next allowed actions take event_seq +1 and +2 and settle PROCESSED

Selection plus inspection: the one Table is found by role, PID 4102's row ItemId is read from the semantic model the table binds (never from the native table), SemanticNodeHandle.select sends a SELECTION_CHANGED of the same shape, logical class and settlement as a native row selection (event_seq +1), and the inspector, found by its first line's text and its parent's children, reads the selected process's four lines and its command-line text

Developer-only semantic inspection output (test output, written to PX026_EVIDENCE_DIR when set): one line per node with its semantic ID, registry role, label, text, value, accessible description, non-default state, accepted standard events, server-advertised actions, action key, shortcut and child count, built only from the T35 snapshot; it names none of the native classes the renderer built, matches no NS* type or pointer pattern, and a bounded reflection walk of the snapshot reaches no NSObject

No external automation endpoint: lsof (-F field output) of the test process before the inspector is made and after every automated action lists no new TCP LISTEN, UDP or path-bound unix socket (measured: no socket at all either time); a TCP and a unix control listener opened, listed and closed by the test prove the listing would see one; the diff adds no listener API outside that test control and changes no client, SDK, runtime or srtop source
